faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common
faq.subtitle: Quick answers before we start talking.

items.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.answer: Web applications, internal tools, automation systems, AI integrations, and mobile apps. I focus on projects that solve real operational problems for businesses.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: It depends on scope. A landing page or simple tool takes 1–2 weeks. A full web application takes 4–8 weeks. I'll give you a clear timeline after understanding your needs.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Cameroon?
items.answer: Yes. I work remotely with clients worldwide. Communication happens via WhatsApp, email, or video calls depending on your preference.

items.question: What technologies do you primarily use?
items.answer: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, n8n for automation, and various databases. I choose the stack that best fits your project's needs, not the other way around.

items.question: Can you work with an existing team or codebase?
items.answer: Absolutely. I can join your team as a contractor, take over an existing project, or build something new from scratch.
